name: Counting multiples in a range
whenToUse: How many integers in a range are divisible by a number, the building block of most inclusion-exclusion and complementary counting.
example: Multiples of $7$ from $100$ to $300$: $\left\lfloor \frac{300}{7} \right\rfloor - \left\lfloor \frac{99}{7} \right\rfloor = 42 - 14 = 28$. They run from $7 \cdot 15 = 105$ to $7 \cdot 42 = 294$.
pitfall: Subtract the count up to $a - 1$, not up to $a$, or you lose $a$ itself when $a$ is a multiple.
